findings.resolution: Remove the composite action from the workflow. Reproduce its Linux tar archive step locally and upload artifact.tar with the already reviewed immutable actions/upload-artifact pin.

The workflow is advisory and is not used as release authority, but its mutable transitive container base remains real. Either exclude this advisory integration from the v1 authoritative supply-chain claim or replace it with a digest/source-built path before claiming full transitive immutability.

non_claims: A direct commit pin does not prove that an upstream composite or Docker action has immutable transitive dependencies.
This review does not claim the PR-Agent container tag is compromised.
The PR-Agent disposition remains a human release-scope decision.
